critique.evidence: Measured rendering is demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–72 ms, LCP 308–1288 ms, TTFB 1.5–7.5 ms, and load/DCL 129–154 ms. Layout stability is strong on desktop/mobile (CLS 0.0011/0) and acceptable on tablet (0.0478). Frame samples show no long frames; worst frame was 33.4 ms on desktop and 16.8 ms on tablet/mobile. There were no console, page, or request failures and no horizontal overflow. The main limitation is payload efficiency: 1,314,033–1,314,034 transferred bytes, including 1,148,910 JS bytes, plus 17 requests and calls to multiple non-vault endpoints.
critique.fix: Reduce the 1.15 MB JavaScript payload with route-level code splitting and lazy-load data/assets for screens other than vault. Avoid fetching unrelated endpoints during vault startup, and investigate the tablet-only CLS of 0.0478 by reserving stable dimensions for late-rendered content.
